cases.title: Control returns requestState only for an ASK outcome to an MRTR client
cases.when: POST access/invocations with tasks.declared=false for a tool whose policy is ASK, once from an MRTR client and once from a legacy client
then: The MRTR request gets InvocationAdmission with requestState and approvalUrl
The legacy request gets no requestState

cases.title: A modified requestState is refused
cases.when: The retry carries requestState with one payload byte changed
then: 409; the invocation does not continue; audit records the rejection

cases.title: An expired requestState is refused
cases.when: The retry arrives after exp (which is at most the approval expiry and at most 10 minutes)

cases.title: A requestState presented by another identity or scope is refused
cases.when: A second agent retries with the first agent's requestState
then: Refused; the response reveals nothing about the first invocation

cases.title: A requestState presented with different arguments is refused
cases.when: The retry carries the original requestState but different arguments

cases.title: A requestState is accepted once
cases.when: The same valid requestState is presented twice after approval
then: The first retry continues the invocation; the second is refused

cases.title: Standalone SDKs mint requestState with a per-process key of at least 256 bits
cases.when: A standalone runtime starts twice and issues requestState each time
then: A token from the first process is rejected by the second
